items.headline: [InboxPilot](https://github.com/Xuefeng-Zhu/InboxPilot)
points: Developed a multi-tenant AI support workspace unifying SMS, email, and web chat with retrieval-grounded drafts, confidence-gated auto-replies, deterministic escalation, real-time updates, and auditable human handoffs.
Separated portable business logic from provider adapters and backed asynchronous processing with a retrying PostgreSQL job queue, tenant RLS, append-only audit logs, and persisted RAG evidence.

items.headline: [ChronoGuard](https://github.com/Xuefeng-Zhu/ChronoGuard)
points: Built an AI rollout-safety control plane for staged releases with deterministic guardrails, durable investigations, approval-gated mitigations, and recovery verification.
Combined tenant-scoped PostgreSQL state, ClickHouse telemetry, resumable Trigger.dev workflows, bounded parameterized queries, signed actions, and immutable audit trails.

items.headline: [OpenSlot](https://github.com/Xuefeng-Zhu/OpenSlot)
points: Built a server-first scheduling platform with timezone-aware availability, short-lived slot holds, conflict-free booking, cancellations and rescheduling, calendar sync, and reliable outbox-driven side effects.

Protected booking integrity with PostgreSQL RLS and exclusion constraints, idempotent mutations, database-backed rate limits, and authenticated worker routes for email, calendar, and webhook delivery.

items.headline: [PromptDock](https://github.com/Xuefeng-Zhu/PromptDock)
points: Created a local-first prompt recipe manager with reusable template variables, a global desktop launcher, cross-app paste, versioned import/export, and optional multi-user Firebase synchronization.
Implemented role-based workspaces, invitations, offline-synced mode, conflict review, and storage adapters spanning Tauri JSON files, browser localStorage, and Cloud Firestore.

items.headline: [SheetSQL](https://github.com/Xuefeng-Zhu/SheetSQL)
points: Developed a SQL engine for Google Sheets supporting table mutations, joins, unions, subqueries, aggregates, filtering, grouping, ordering, and limits through custom menus and cell formulas.
Earned 141 GitHub stars and 10 forks for bringing familiar relational-query workflows to spreadsheet-backed tables.
